description: This PHP source file defines the 'SurveyQuestionOptionsDashlet' class, which extends the 'DashletGeneric' class to implement a custom dashlet component for SurveyQuestionOptions within SugarCRM / SuiteCRM. It includes constructor initialization, loading metadata, setting display titles, search fields, columns, and seed bean configuration.

classes.name: SurveyQuestionOptionsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for SurveyQuestionOptions, extending DashletGeneric, responsible for initializing dashlet properties such as title, search fields, columns, and seed bean based on metadata and global variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the dashlet by loading metadata, setting the title (with translation fallback), search fields, columns, and seed bean.
